visual_overrides.core_identity: A normal-looking sword animated by magic; the weapon itself is the creature and moves with no hand, arm, ghost, or visible wielder.
visual_overrides.silhouette: One complete sword suspended horizontally or diagonally with a clean readable blade-and-hilt silhouette.
visual_overrides.body_shape: One complete sword with blade, guard, grip, and pommel; no added limbs.
